rejection_reasons: runner_used_only_seven_raw_features: the runner built a dynamic feature union from row.predictive_features instead of invoking the 47-feature SentinelFeatureCatalog
forty_seven_feature_builder_not_invoked: build_sentinel_features was never called by the production runner
declared_fifty_thousand_support_not_consumed: production_dev_test_legitimate=50000 was declared but build_v5_corpus divided production_profile.legitimate_decisions across four partitions
actual_legitimate_support_was_12500: development-test contained only 12500 legitimate decisions, far below the 50000 requirement
no_real_task5_rail_ledger_execution: fraud rows were fabricated with string provenance, not derived from Task 5 campaigns or real rail adapters
no_real_trust_integration: trust_failure was never passed to SentinelDefender from the runner
null_latency_and_missing_ece: p50/p95/p99 latency were null and ECE was not computed
only_one_arm: comparison arms (rules_only, ensemble_no_graph, ensemble_with_graph) were absent
independent_verifier_remained_forgeable: verifier did not reject ready with null latency before the fix
evidence_policy: Metrics from this experiment cannot support readiness, adaptive search, or competition claims.
